cast.croc: a big green cartoon crocodile with a long bumpy snout, small yellow eyes and white pointy teeth
cast.mom: a stick-figure mother with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs and a long brown cloak
cast.boy: a small stick-figure boy with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs and a tan tunic

lines.text: Why couldn't a hungry crocodile keep one simple promise?
lines.label: THE PARADOX
lines.headline: THE CROCODILE'S PROMISE
lines.image: {croc} standing waist-deep in a calm river holding {boy}, while {mom} stands on the sandy riverbank looking at them, a stone castle on a far hill

lines.text: Long ago, a crocodile grabbed a little boy playing by the river.
lines.label: LONG AGO
lines.headline: A BOY BY THE RIVER
lines.image: {croc} lunging out of the river and snatching {boy} off the sandy riverbank, splashing water, {boy} looking scared

lines.text: The boy's mother begged the crocodile to give her son back.
lines.label: A MOTHER BEGS
lines.headline: PLEASE GIVE HIM BACK
lines.image: {mom} kneeling on the sandy riverbank with both arms reaching out, pleading toward {croc}, who holds {boy} in the shallow river

lines.text: The crocodile grinned and said, "Guess what I will do, and he goes home."
lines.label: THE DEAL
lines.headline: GUESS RIGHT, HE GOES HOME
lines.image: close-up of {croc} grinning slyly in the river and pointing one claw at {mom} on the riverbank, holding {boy} in its other arm

lines.text: "But guess wrong," it said, "and I eat him for lunch."
lines.label: THE CATCH
lines.headline: GUESS WRONG, HE'S LUNCH
lines.image: {croc} in the river opening its huge jaws wide next to {boy}, who looks terrified, licking its lips hungrily

lines.text: The mother thought hard, then said, "You will not give him back."
lines.label: HER GUESS
lines.headline: YOU WON'T GIVE HIM BACK
lines.image: {mom} standing tall on the riverbank, one finger raised, looking calm and clever, speaking to {croc} who holds {boy} in the river

lines.text: If it gives him back, her guess was wrong, so it must eat him.
lines.label: CHOICE ONE
lines.headline: IF IT GIVES HIM BACK
lines.image: {croc} at the edge of the river setting {boy} down on the sand in front of {mom}, but {croc} pausing with a worried frown

lines.text: But if it eats him, her guess was right, so it must give him back.
lines.label: CHOICE TWO
lines.headline: IF IT EATS HIM
lines.image: {croc} in the river lifting {boy} toward its wide open jaws, then freezing with a worried frown, {mom} watching from the riverbank

lines.text: Either way, the crocodile breaks its own promise, so it's stuck.
lines.label: THE TWIST
lines.headline: NO WAY TO KEEP ITS WORD
lines.image: {croc} sitting in the river scratching its head with one claw, eyes spinning in dizzy confusion, holding {boy} loosely, {mom} watching from the riverbank

lines.text: So the confused crocodile let the boy go, and he ran home safe.
lines.label: THE ANSWER
lines.headline: THE PROMISE THAT BROKE ITSELF
lines.image: {boy} running happily across the sandy riverbank into the open arms of {mom}, while {croc} sits in the river behind them looking puzzled, warm sunset light
